qualification.education_qualification: MBA in Marketing or Master's/Postgraduate Degree in Communication/Advertising; Master Degree in Luxury Brand Management, Retail Operations or Fashion Management; MBA or Equivalent Post-Graduate Degree in Management with specializations in Product or Systems Management; MBA (HR)/Master's Degree in Human Resource Management/Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Welfare or Post Graduate Degree in Management with specialization in Human Resources.
qualification.details: Consultant - Marketing: MBA in Marketing or a Master's/Postgraduate Degree in Communication/Advertising from a premier global or national institutions. Experience: 8-12 years of experience in Brand Management with a significant tenure in Lifestyle, Luxury or Heritage Sectors. Consultant - Retail Operations: Master Degree in Luxury Brand Management, Retail Operations or Fashion Management from a premier institute. Experience: 10+ years of experience in premium or Luxury retail with at least 5 years in a senior leadership capacity managing large-format flagship Operations. Consultant - IT: An MBA or Equivalent Post-Graduate Degree in Management, with specializations in Product or Systems Management preferred. Experience: Minimum 5-7 years in digital Product Management, Managing Cross-functional teams of developer and UI/UX designers. Special Advisor For Undertaking Organizational Restructuring, Industrial Relations Management & Human Resources Optimization On Project Basis: MBA (HR)/Master's Degree in Human Resource Management/Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Welfare from a recognized University/institution. OR Post Graduate Degree in Management with specialization in Human Resources. Additional qualifications in Labour Laws, Organizational Development, Public Administration or Change Management will be desirable. Experience: Minimum 20 years of post-qualification experience in Human Resource Management, Industrial Relations, Organizational Development, or Administration. Out of the above, at least 10 years should be in a senior managerial position (General Manager/Executive Director/Director or equivalent) in: Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSES), Government Organizations, Autonomous Bodies, Statutory Organizations, Reputed Private Sector Organizations having workforce management of substantial scale.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Central Cottage Industries Corporation of India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Central Cottage Industries Corporation of India Recruitment 2026 is 25th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Consultant and Special Advisor positions in the Central Cottage Industries Corporation of India Recruitment 2026. These include specialized roles in Marketing, Retail Operations, IT, and HR.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post. Generally, an MBA in Marketing, Master's in Communication/Advertising, Master's in Luxury Brand Management/Retail Operations/Fashion Management, or an MBA (HR)/Master's in Human Resource Management is required. Please refer to the detailed notification for specific post requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Consultant and Special Advisor positions?
faq.answer: For Consultant posts, the maximum age limit is 45 years. For the Special Advisor role, the maximum age limit is 65 years. Age relaxation may be considered in deserving cases as per the organization's policy.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the Consultant posts is Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) all-inclusive per month. For the Special Advisor position, the fee is negotiable based on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Central Cottage Industries Corporation of India Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it through post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification for any updates or specific instructions regarding fees.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contract basis. The recruitment is for Consultant and Special Advisor positions, indicating a project-based or fixed-term engagement.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and the application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Central Cottage Industries Corporation of India, specifically from the 'openings' section. The link is provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the experience required for the Special Advisor role?
faq.answer: The Special Advisor role requires a minimum of 20 years of post-qualification experience in HR Management, Industrial Relations, or related fields, with at least 10 years in a senior managerial position in PSUs, government organizations, or reputed private sector entities.
